stem: Which separation is the explicit purpose attributed to the cepstrum on the MFCC slide?

options.text: Separate successive temporal frames so that every static coefficient becomes a temporal derivative.
Separate the speaker’s voice-source or excitation contribution from vocal-tract characteristics.
Separate the microphone channel response from room reverberation to characterize the recording conditions.
Separate phoneme-transition speed from total utterance duration to normalize the timing of speech.

citations.locator: Lecture L48, physical PDF page 1521, printed footer 15: Third bullet: cepstrum helps separate voice source from vocal-tract characteristics.

difficultyRationale: Direct source interpretation or a short specified operation.
